Emergency Repairs

Slipped tiles, storm damage and leaks dealt with, usually in a day. We're open 24 hours.

How We Do Emergency Repairs

We deal with slipped tiles, storm damage and leaks, and carry out roof inspections, gutter cleaning, moss removal and planned maintenance.

Is It Urgent?

If water is coming in, or tiles have come loose above a path or doorway, treat it as urgent and call us. Our first job is to minimise the damage and secure the property. Then we'll tell you what the lasting repair is. Tell us what you can see from the ground, and send a photo if it's safe to take one. Don't go up a ladder or onto the roof yourself.

Stopping It Happening Again

Regular inspections pick up damaged tiles, leaks and worn materials before they turn into costly repairs. We replace damaged tiles, repair flashing and seal minor leaks, and we offer planned maintenance for homeowners, landlords and businesses.

When to Call Us Out

  • A slipped or missing tile or slate
  • Water coming through a ceiling
  • Storm damage to the roof or ridge
  • A gutter that has come away or is overflowing

How Long It Takes

An emergency repair usually takes us 1 day.
